description: Cancel a subscription. By default it stays active until the end of the current term (`term_end`); pass timeframe `bill_date` to cancel effective the next bill date. This changes billing state. Recurly: PUT /subscriptions/{subscription_id}/cancel.

timeframe.description: When cancellation takes effect. Default term_end (end of current term).

name: recurly_cancel_subscription
title: Cancel subscription (WRITE — changes billing)
